findings.problem: The hint 'an opportunity' leads just as naturally to die Gelegenheit (or die Möglichkeit), so the prompt has more than one right answer.
findings.fix: hint: an opportunity; the look-alike word, not Gelegenheit

back.target: chance, opportunity (a possibility of doing or getting something)

note: German speakers say Chance either as SHAHN-suh, the French way, or as SHANG-suh; the trick's version is fine.
